system.description:
Requirements You have a free hand or a weapon with the Grapple Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard.
Critical Success The target is Restrained until the end of the next round. Success The target is Grabbed until the end of the next round. Graze No effect. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.
❷ Tackle. Move, then Grapple. Critical Success The target is Restrained until the end of the next round and knocked Prone. Success The target is Grabbed until the end of the next round and knocked Prone. You fall Prone adjacent to them. Graze No effect, and you are Exposed in a Zone of the defender's choice. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity, and fall Prone adjacent to them.
